blocks.text: TOKYO, Japan — Binibining Pilipinas Katrina Anne Johnson has brought along with her to her 2026 Miss International journey the children whose lives has touched hers through her initiative on inclusivity. But she did not literally bring them with her to Japan, where the international pageant is taking place. The children came with her through the special embelishments attached to her dress when she presented her SDG (sustainable development goal) initiative at a pre-final event. On her dress were small butterfly-patterned appliqués scattered around. But they were not just mere representations of the winged creatures. They were made of pieces of […]...
